**Verdict: Yes to all four checks.**

1.  **Visible Trays:** The tall column **T-101** is rendered with multiple horizontal lines inside its outline, clearly representing the internal trays/stages.
2.  **Stream Routing:** Stream lines are routed cleanly and do not cross or overlap the unit labels (E-102 CONDENSER, V-101 REFLUX DRUM, E-103 REBOILER, E-101 FEED PREHEATER).
3.  **Product Annotations:** Both "**BENZENE PRODUCT**" (top right) and "**TOLUENE PRODUCT**" (bottom right) are clearly labeled inside the main drawing sheet.
4.  **Title Block:** A title block is present in the upper right corner of the drawing area, containing the project name ("BENZENE-TOLUENE"), document type ("DISTILLATION · PFD"), and revision info ("SHEET 1 OF 1 · REV A").
